findings.title: Group filter uses GetAbility(def) without includeTemporary, so hediff-granted grouped abilities never join the menu
findings.detail: OpenMenu line 148 calls p.abilities?.GetAbility(def), which only searches the permanent `abilities` list. Vanilla builds gizmos (and so the grouped button) from AllAbilitiesForReading, which adds hediff, equipment, apparel, royalty and ideology-role abilities. Two of the three vanilla groupAbility defs (GhoulFrenzy at Anomaly Abilities.xml:519 and MetalbloodInjection at :611) are granted by implants (Hediffs_BodyParts_Prosthetic.xml:479/650), so with several ghouls selected the grouped menu sets the mode on the clicked ghoul only. Change it to GetAbility(def, true).

findings.title: Group filter omits vanilla's GizmosVisible() and showWhenDrafted checks
findings.detail: Vanilla shows an ability gizmo only when (Drafted || displayGizmoWhileUndrafted) && a.GizmosVisible() (Pawn_AbilityTracker.cs:162) and (!Drafted || def.showWhenDrafted) (Ability.GetGizmos). The filter copies only the first clause, so a selected pawn whose gizmo is hidden by an effect comp or by showWhenDrafted=false would get the mode without being in the grouped button. No vanilla groupAbility def hits this; adding `&& a.GizmosVisible() && (!p.Drafted || def.showWhenDrafted)` matches vanilla exactly.

findings.title: Shrunk-path menu title reads a defaultLabel that GizmoOnGUIShrunk never refreshes
findings.detail: Command_Ability.GizmoOnGUI sets defaultLabel to pawnLabel/originalLabel from parms.multipleSelected; Command.GizmoOnGUIShrunk goes straight to GizmoOnGUIInt and never does. So for a shrunk, ungrouped ability gizmo, command.LabelCap is whatever the cached gizmo last had at full size (usually the plain label), not 'Ability (Name)' as the comment at line 197 says. Cosmetic only.
